rules.title: PEP 8 with Ruff
rules.text: Follow PEP 8 and use Ruff for linting and formatting.

rules.title: Type hints
rules.text: Add type hints to all function signatures and run mypy or pyright.

rules.title: pathlib
rules.text: Use pathlib for filesystem paths and context managers for resources.

rules.title: Dataclasses or Pydantic
rules.text: Model structured data with dataclasses or Pydantic, not loose dicts.

rules.title: uv for environments
rules.text: Manage dependencies and virtual environments with uv and commit the lockfile.

rules.title: pytest
rules.text: Write tests with pytest, using fixtures and parametrize instead of loops.

rules.title: Specific exceptions
rules.text: Catch specific exceptions, never bare except.
